response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, technically diverse senior software engineer with impressive open-source and full-stack experience, but he lacks the explicit leadership/management track record, Python and UML experience, and—critically—only has 'Basic' German proficiency against a stated minimum C1 requirement for a client-facing Head of Development role in Germany.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software development experience across web, mobile, backend and embedded systems
Strong open-source track record (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial) showing Linux/Unix affinity and community engagement
Demonstrated ability to mentor and run workshops/trainings (Selenium course, Web Internals, Testing workshops)
concerns: German proficiency listed as 'Basic', far below the required C1 minimum for client advisory work
No clear evidence of formal team leadership, project management, or client-facing architecture advisory roles
No mention of UML, Python, or formal risk/security/compliance experience required for the role

key_factors.factor: German language proficiency below C1 requirement
Lack of explicit leadership/PM and client advisory experience
Strong technical breadth and open-source/Linux background
